# Module `lune_ui_core::theme`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

UI tokens read by the toolkit's widgets, and the Lunegit dark preset.

A [`Theme`](theme.md#struct.Theme) is a plain `Copy` value carried by the [`Painter`](paint.md#struct.Painter), so one
process can draw with more than one theme. [`lunegit_dark`](theme/lunegit_dark.md) holds the values copied from
Lunegit's `DarkTheme.axaml` and `App.axaml`, plus its glass layers. A theme file (JSON, read by
the bounded reader in [`crate::json`](json.md)) overlays some of those values: [`Theme::from_json`](theme.md#method.Theme.from_json). The
table from a file's colour key to the [`Theme`](theme.md#struct.Theme) field it sets is [`COLOR_KEYS`](theme.md#constant.COLOR_KEYS) and `color_slot`
below, in this file because the keys carry Lunegit's names.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/theme.rs:1`

**Methods and associated items**

`impl Theme`

- <a id="method.Theme.from_json"></a>`pub fn from_json(bytes: &[u8], base: &Theme) -> Result<ThemeFile, ThemeError>`

  Reads a theme file over `base`: the file's colours and glass opacities replace the base's,
  the fields derived from them follow (below), everything else keeps the base value.

  Derived fields, each only when its source key was applied (so the preset's values are
  reproduced exactly by a file that sets the preset's sources): `scroll_thumb`, `scroll_thumb_hover` and
  `text_selection` (the accent at alpha 0x8C, 0xE6, 0x66), `diff_added_mark` and
  `diff_removed_mark` (the line fill at alpha 0x40), and the three `menu_text_*` colours (the
  matching `fg_*`).

  Errors name the envelope's fault: not JSON, not an object, `name`, `colors` or `acrylic`
  absent or of the wrong type, an empty `name`, `author` or `version` of the wrong type, a
  `glass` that is not an object. `author` may be null or absent; `version` is an exact
  integer or absent; `glass` is optional (the module comment has its schema).

`impl Theme`

- <a id="method.Theme.color_key"></a>`pub fn color_key(&self, key: &str) -> Option<Rgba>`

  The colour a theme file's colour `key` sets in this theme (the first field it sets, when
  it sets more than one), or `None` for a key that is not in [`COLOR_KEYS`](theme.md#constant.COLOR_KEYS).

- <a id="method.Theme.with_acrylic"></a>`pub fn with_acrylic(self, level: AcrylicLevel) -> Theme`
  `#[must_use]`

  The theme with its three glass material opacities scaled by `level`, each clamped to
  [0, 1]. Tint opacities never scale. (Lunegit `ThemeApplicator.ApplyAcrylicSettings`: 0.7
  gives 0.35, 0.85 and 1; 0.8 gives 0.4, 0.9 and 1.)

<a id="enum.Skip"></a>
### Enum `Skip`

```rust
pub enum Skip {
    UnknownColor(String),
    BadColor(String),
    UnknownAcrylic(String),
    BadAcrylic(String),
    UnknownGlass(String),
    BadGlass(String),
    BadMaterial(String),
}
```

A key of the file that was not applied; the string is the key (at most 256 bytes).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/theme/file.rs:60`

**Variants**

- <a id="variant.Skip.UnknownColor"></a>`UnknownColor(String)`

  A colour key with no `Theme` field.

- <a id="variant.Skip.BadColor"></a>`BadColor(String)`

  A known colour key whose value is not `#RRGGBB` or `#AARRGGBB`.

- <a id="variant.Skip.UnknownAcrylic"></a>`UnknownAcrylic(String)`

  An acrylic key that sets nothing here.

- <a id="variant.Skip.BadAcrylic"></a>`BadAcrylic(String)`

  A known acrylic key whose value is outside [0, 1].

- <a id="variant.Skip.UnknownGlass"></a>`UnknownGlass(String)`

  A `glass` key that sets nothing: the key (`foo`) or a layer's key (`window.foo`).

- <a id="variant.Skip.BadGlass"></a>`BadGlass(String)`

  A known `glass` layer member that is not a number in [0, 1] or a colour, or a layer that is
  not an object: its path, such as `window.blackMaxOpacity` or `card`.

- <a id="variant.Skip.BadMaterial"></a>`BadMaterial(String)`

  The `glass.material` had a fault, so none of it applied: the path of the first fault, such
  as `material.macos.effect`.
